598:t_1:3.en: ～ $$シャイアン基地$$ Underground　$$コロニーレーザー$$ Control Room ～

598:t_1:4.en:
$$マーサ$$
「...It seems our prized strike force has lost to $c.」

598:t_1:5.en:
$$ローナン$$
「So even that $$バンシィ$$ the Foundation provided wasn't powerful enough.」

598:t_1:6.en:
$$アルベルト$$
($$ローナン・マーセナス$$ doesn't know the $$バンシィ$$'s pilot is his son, Ensign $$リディ$$...)

598:t_1:7.en:
$$アルベルト$$
(If he knew, he probably couldn't do something like this...)

598:t_1:8.en:
$$マーサ$$
「They were merely a scouting force... Our real weapon is the $$コロニーレーザー$$ the $$宇宙革命軍$$ prepared during the $$多元戦争$$...」

598:t_1:9.en:
$$ローナン$$
「Only people connected with $$クロノ$$ know it is operational.」

598:t_1:10.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Judging from their course, $c and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ seem to be heading for $$インダストリアル７$$.」

598:t_1:11.en:
$$マーサ$$
「In other words, the Box is there...」

598:t_1:12.en:
$$ローナン$$
「If they become embroiled in battle, all the better. We'll dispose of the Box and the troublemakers together with the $$コロニーレーザー$$.」

598:t_1:13.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「...Are you really sure about this?」

598:t_1:14.en:
$$ローナン$$
「What are you trying to say?」

598:t_1:15.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「I have serious doubts that doing this will benefit humanity's future.」

598:t_1:16.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Losing $c would mean losing those who protect the dignity of Earth's humanity...」

598:t_1:17.en:
$$マーサ$$
「You must be tired, $$アルベルト$$.」

598:t_1:19.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Get some rest, $$アルベルト$$. ...That is an order.」

598:t_1:21.en:
$$マーサ$$
「...I'm afraid you had to witness an unsightly scene.」

598:t_1:22.en:
$$ローナン$$
「I hear he traveled with $c.」

598:t_1:23.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Yes... That seems to have filled him with needless illusions.」

598:t_1:24.en:
$$ローナン$$
「...He was just like $$リディ$$ used to be...」

598:t_1:25.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I'm impressed by your skill in correcting your son's ways, Chairman.」

598:t_1:26.en:
$$ローナン$$
「I... merely fulfilled my duty as a father.」

598:t_1:28.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Speaking of which, what did $$キング$$ say about this operation?」

598:t_1:29.en:
$$ローナン$$
「He said he would leave everything to me. He no longer does anything but watch events unfold.」

598:t_1:30.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Then... it is possible that $$クロノ$$'s highest authority might change hands.」

598:t_1:31.en:
$$ローナン$$
「It is not impossible. $$キング$$ has lost his successor, after all.」

598:t_1:33.en:
$$ローナン$$
「Depending on the circumstances, my son may become the new $$キング$$.」

598:t_1:34.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Succession by blood... Those blood ties are what have allowed $$クロノ$$ to keep its secrets to this day.」

598:t_1:35.en:
$$ローナン$$
(Where are you, $$リディ$$...? Soon, the world will belong entirely to $$サイデリアル$$.)

598:t_1:36.en:
$$ローナン$$
(To ensure the survival of Earth's human species, there are any number of things I need you to do within $$クロノ$$...)

598:t_1:38.en:
$$アルベルト$$
(You... were my light... As long as I had you, I could endure this miserable life...)

598:t_1:39.en:
$$アルベルト$$
(And yet... and yet, you...)

598:t_1:40.en:
$$マーサ$$
「What are you doing, $$アルベルト$$? If you aren't feeling well...」

598:t_1:41.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「You...! Didn't either of you feel anything when her life was snuffed out!?」

598:t_1:43.en:
$$マーサ$$
「You seem tired, $$アルベルト$$. Get some rest.」

598:t_1:44.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「I have something to say first! What you're trying to do is wrong!」

598:t_1:45.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「You'll operate the $$コロニーレーザー$$ from Earth and wipe out $c and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ at once...! If you do that, humanity's future will...」

598:t_1:46.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Get some rest, $$アルベルト$$. ...That is an order.」

598:t_1:49.en:
$$マーサ$$
「...I'm afraid you had to witness an unsightly scene.」

598:t_1:50.en:
$$ローナン$$
「It doesn't matter. I am well aware that what I'm doing is a cowardly expedient.」

598:t_1:56.en:

598:t_1:76.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「The $$プトレマイオス２$$... has gone on ahead.」

598:t_1:77.en:
$$レイアム$$
「They'll cover as much distance as they can with $$トランザム$$, then send out the $$ユニコーン$$...」

598:t_1:78.en:
$$オットー$$
「We're effectively using all of $c as a decoy. It will succeed without fail.」

598:t_1:79.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$インダストリアル７$$... Will everything finally be settled there...?」

598:t_1:80.en:
$$オットー$$
「It was where everything began, too... Come to think of it, that's how long I've known you, Captain.」

598:t_1:81.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I never imagined I'd see the end of it from the bridge of this ship.」

598:t_1:83.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...I think none of this would have happened if someone other than $$バナージ$$ had piloted the $$ユニコーン$$.」

598:t_1:85.en:
$$オットー$$
「And now, they're trying to fulfill their mission to bring it all to an end.」
